key.trade-cycling-automator.toggle: Start or stop Trade Cycling automation
text.trade-cycling-automator.config.intr: Open a villager and press the book button at the top right of the trade screen. Pick one or more offers, then Start. The enchantment controls below are only used by the older Trade Cycling driver.
text.trade-cycling-automator.panel.title: %s trades
text.trade-cycling-automator.locked: This villager has already been traded with, so the offers are locked
text.trade-cycling-automator.no_job_site: No job site block was found next to this villager
text.trade-cycling-automator.out_of_reac: Move closer to the job site block
text.trade-cycling-automator.need_block: Put the job site block in your inventory first
text.trade-cycling-automator.need_tool: You need a tool that can break the job site block
text.trade-cycling-automator.timeout: Stopped because the villager did not refresh in time
text.trade-cycling-automator.no_professi: This villager has no profession to reroll
text.trade-cycling-automator.need_target: Choose a trade in the list first
text.trade-cycling-automator.config.enab: When this is off, the keybind will not start cycling.
text.trade-cycling-automator.config.leve: Levels above that enchantment's maximum are rejected.
text.trade-cycling-automator.config.max_: Must sit inside the wiki minimum and maximum for this enchantment and level, before reputation discounts. A live trade matches when the emeralds shown are at or under this number.
Stop after this many cycle requests. Default is 500.
text.trade-cycling-automator.config.pani: Turn this on and save to stop automation immediately. It is not remembered.
text.trade-cycling-automator.gui_closed: Stopped because the trade screen closed
text.trade-cycling-automator.not_librari: Stopped because this is not a librarian
text.trade-cycling-automator.disabled: Automation is disabled in the config
text.trade-cycling-automator.cannot_cycl: Stopped because this villager has already been traded with
text.trade-cycling-automator.invalid: That enchantment, level, and price cannot be saved
text.trade-cycling-automator.no_offers: Stopped because the librarian has no trades yet
text.trade-cycling-automator.need_screen: Open a librarian trade screen first
text.trade-cycling-automator.invalid.unk: That enchantment is not a librarian book
